postings.title: Project Controller DS&C (Viet Nam)
postings.description:
We offer you an Ocean of Possibilities. Join our family.

About us

The goal of Damen Song Cam is to develop, design and construct a portfolio of tugboats, and high-speed crafts in the most effective and efficient manner. Primarily based on standardized & smart-customized designs. Damen Song Cam is fulfilling current and developing market demands, with well-balanced levels of quality, service, price, and delivery time; thereby providing optimal solutions for our clients. Our vessels are produced at our yards in Zone Hoang Lam 1, Thien Huong Ward, Hai Phong City, Vietnam as well as in other countries such as Singapore, China, Turkey and The Netherlands.

About Damen Vietnam Shared Services Centre (SSC)
Damen Vietnam Shared Services Centre is part of Damen Group's global shared services organisation. The SSC provides professional support services to various Damen business units worldwide. This position will be employed through the SSC in Vietnam while working closely with the OSV Finance organisation in the Netherlands and supporting shipbuilding projects across Vietnam

The role

As Project Controller, you are responsible for the financial control of a portfolio of shipbuilding projects executed in Vietnam for Damen Offshore & Specialized Vessels, OSV.

Although the position is based at Song Cam Shipyard, OSV builds ships at various Damen and partner shipyards throughout Vietnam. You will therefore support projects across multiple locations and work closely with Project Managers, site teams, shipyards and the OSV Finance organization in the Netherlands.

The role requires frequent travel within Vietnam. Depending on the project portfolio and project phase, you may spend several weeks per month working at other shipyards or project locations.

You monitor project performance, challenge forecasts, analyse margin and cash flow development, and support Project Managers with clear financial insight.

You will typically work on medium-sized or moderately complex projects, while also supporting Senior Project Controllers on larger or higher risk projects. This makes the role suitable for someone with a solid finance foundation who wants to develop further in an international, project driven and technical environment.

You are part of the OSV Finance and Control organization, where Project Control plays a key role in understanding project performance, improving forecast quality and supporting better decision making across the business.

Key responsibilities:

As a Project Controller DS&C, your tasks are the following:

- Maintain a visible presence at the shipyards where OSV vessels are being built and act as the financial counterpart to local Project Managers, site teams and yard management
- Monitor physical progress, project milestones, procurement status and yard activities, and translate these developments into their financial impact
- Verify that reported progress, forecasts and expected costs reflect the actual situation at the shipyard
- Identify emerging cost overruns, delays, scope changes, productivity issues and cash flow risks at an early stage
- Challenge project forecasts and assumptions based on direct observations, discussions with local teams and supporting project documentation
- Monitor project budgets, margins, risks, commitments, cash flow and expected final results
- Prepare periodic project reports, variance analyses and forecast updates for the OSV Finance organization in the Netherlands
- Support Project Managers and site teams with practical financial insight, scenario analyses and decision support
- Monitor the financial consequences of changes in planning, engineering, procurement, production and delivery
- Ensure that project costs, commitments, accruals and progress are recorded accurately and on time
- Review and reconcile financial information received from shipyards, suppliers and local project teams
- Maintain complete and reliable project control files and supporting documentation
- Escalate significant financial or operational issues promptly to the Finance Director OSV and the responsible Project Manager
- Support OSV projects at multiple Damen and partner shipyards throughout Vietnam, including extended periods at locations outside Song Cam
- Strengthen the connection between project execution in Vietnam and project reporting and decision making in the Netherlands
- Contribute to more consistent project control processes, reporting standards and working methods across OSV projects in Vietnam

Skills & experience

To be successful in this role you bring:

- Native Vietnamese speaker with an excellent command of English, both written and spoken
- A completed Bachelor or a Master degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related field
- Approximately 3 to 6 years of relevant experience in project controlling, finance, audit, consultancy, project administration or financial analysis
- Experience in a project driven environment is preferred
- Experience in shipbuilding, engineering, construction or manufacturing is an advantage
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate financial information into practical business insights
- Comfortable working with project budgets, forecasts, margins, risks and cash flow
- Proactive, accurate and able to work independently across different locations
- Able to challenge constructively and communicate clearly with both financial and operational stakeholders
- Comfortable working with Excel and financial or ERP systems
- SAP experience is an advantage
- Willing and able to travel frequently within Vietnam and spend several weeks per month at other shipyards when required
- Comfortable working in an international organization and collaborating remotely with colleagues in the Netherlands

What we offer

Here at Damen, we realize supporting and managing many talented individuals is of great essence. We understand that the key to success is to find the right person for the right job. That’s why we continually invest in your development. Damen offers you:

- a dynamic international working environment focusing on technology and innovation;
- a competitive salary;
- holiday bonus, Tet bonus, quarter bonus;
- monthly fuel allowance;
- 24/7 insurance + health insurance for employee and spouse
- full social insurance + PIT;
- business trip allowance (if any);
- continuous focus on professional and personal development through training programs.

Other

postings.title: Project Coordinator (zij-instroom)
postings.description:
We offer you an Ocean of Possibilities. Join our family.

De functie

Ben jij iemand die graag overzicht houdt, nauwkeurig werkt en energie krijgt van een goed georganiseerd proces? Dan is deze functie iets voor jou. De technische kennis van de producten leren wij jou.

De functie leent zich uitstekend voor gedeeltelijk thuiswerken, zodat je kunt werken op de plek waar jij het beste kunt focussen. Op kantoor ligt de nadruk vooral op samenwerken, kennisdelen en het opdoen van nieuwe inzichten.

Als Project Coordinator zorg jij ervoor dat collega's in productie en de monteurs efficiënt aan de slag kunnen. Je brengt informatie samen, bewaakt de voortgang en zorgt dat materialen, onderdelen en documentatie op het juiste moment beschikbaar zijn.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van jouw rol is het bepalen, aanvragen en bestellen van de juiste materialen en onderdelen. Je controleert wat nodig is, schakelt met leveranciers en interne afdelingen en bewaakt levertijden. Dankzij jouw voorbereiding kunnen collega's zonder vertraging aan het werk.

Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen Engineering, Productie, Service, Warehouse, QA/QC, Inkoop en Planning. Je zorgt ervoor dat informatie compleet is, materialen beschikbaar zijn en processen soepel verlopen. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar wat nodig is, maar ook naar hoe het slimmer, efficiënter en beter kan.

Technische kennis is mooi meegenomen, maar zeker niet het belangrijkste. We zoeken vooral iemand die georganiseerd werkt, overzicht weet te bewaren en graag samenwerkt met verschillende afdelingen.

Wat ga je doen?

- Bepalen welke materialen, onderdelen en hulpmiddelen nodig zijn voor productie- en servicewerkzaamheden.
- Bestellen van materialen en onderdelen en bewaken van levertijden.
- Afstemmen met leveranciers, Inkoop en interne afdelingen over beschikbaarheid en planning.
- Verwerken, controleren en beheren van projectinformatie, documentatie en stuklijsten.
- Zorgen dat materialen, onderdelen en hulpmiddelen tijdig beschikbaar zijn voor productie en service.
- Afstemmen met Engineering, Productie, Service, Warehouse, QA/QC en Planning om werkzaamheden soepel te laten verlopen.
- Bewaken van project- en magazijnvoorraden en tijdig signaleren van afwijkingen of knelpunten.
- Plannen, prioriteren en structureren van werkzaamheden binnen projectdeadlines.
- Vastleggen en verwerken van wijzigingen zodat informatie actueel en correct blijft.
- Meedenken over verbeteringen in processen en werkwijzen.

Wat breng je mee?

- MBO 4 + werk- en denkniveau.
- Je werkt gestructureerd, nauwkeurig en houdt makkelijk overzicht.
- Je bent organisatorisch sterk en vindt het leuk om zaken te regelen en te coördineren.
- Je communiceert gemakkelijk met verschillende collega's en afdelingen.
- Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.
- Ervaring in planning, logistiek, supply chain, projectondersteuning, administratie, materiaalbeheer, werkvoorbereiding of een vergelijkbare functie is een plus.

Daarnaast is het mooi meegenomen als je:

- Affiniteit hebt met techniek of productieomgevingen.
- Technische informatie kunt interpreteren of bereid bent dit te leren.
- Ervaring hebt binnen de maakindustrie, logistiek of maritieme sector.

Ook interessant voor kandidaten uit andere vakgebieden

Heb je ervaring als planner, logistiek medewerker, supply chain coördinator, administratief medewerker, projectondersteuner, inkoper of materiaalspecialist? Dan nodigen we je nadrukkelijk uit om te reageren.

Wij geloven dat technische kennis aangeleerd kan worden. Jouw nauwkeurigheid, organisatietalent en samenwerkingsvaardigheden zijn voor ons minstens zo belangrijk.

Wat bieden wij?

- Een goed salaris en arbeidsvoorwaarden passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring.
- Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid tot hybride werken.
- 25 vakantiedagen plus 13 ADV-dagen, met de mogelijkheid ADV-dagen te verkopen.
- Een afwisselende functie waarin planning, materialenbeheer en samenwerking centraal staan.
- Veel ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en groei.
- Een internationale werkomgeving met betrokken collega's en korte lijnen.
- Reiskostenvergoeding.

Waarom deze functie?

In deze rol zorg jij ervoor dat projecten soepel verlopen en collega's hun werk goed kunnen uitvoeren. Je combineert planning, coördinatie, materialenbeheer en samenwerking in één veelzijdige functie. Daarmee heb je direct invloed op het succes van onze productie- en serviceactiviteiten.

postings.description:
We offer you an Ocean of Possibilities. Join our family.

Job description

Damen Song Cam Shipyard (DSCS) is a modern shipbuilding facility within the Damen Shipyards Group, delivering a wide range of vessels for international customers. DSCS executes both standard and Engineer-to-Order (ETO) projects, combining detailed engineering, procurement, production, commissioning, and delivery activities.

The Project Management Department plays a key role in achieving project objectives by leading cross-functional teams and coordinating activities across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, Finance, and Commissioning.

Project Managers are responsible for ensuring vessels are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in compliance with contractual, class, flag, and quality requirements. The role requires strong leadership, stakeholder management, project control, risk management, and customer focus.

DSCS continuously pursues operational excellence through digitalization, data-driven decision making, Lean principles, and continuous improvement initiatives. Project Managers are expected to contribute actively to these objectives while ensuring customer satisfaction and sustainable business performance.

PURPOSE AND SCOPE OF THE JOB OF PROJECT MANAGER

Accountable for the successful delivery of assigned vessels in a safe, timely, cost-effective, and quality-compliant manner, ensuring full adherence to contractual, class, statutory, and customer requirements.

Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary project teams through influence, collaboration, and effective stakeholder management across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Planning, Quality, Finance, Commissioning, and Customer organizations.

Drive project performance through proactive risk and opportunity management, data-driven decision making utilizing digital performance management tools, effective customer engagement, and continuous improvement initiatives throughout the project lifecycle from contract handover to vessel delivery and warranty closure.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES/ ACTIVITIES

Team management

- Actively lead the team in his span of control towards realization of department objectives, targets and initiatives.

- Enforce the awareness and compliance with the company Rules, Regulations and Procedures.

- Monitor the workload and define the recruitment necessities. Interview job applicants and decide various types of labor contracts application.

- Identify and propose various Training necessities of his team members.

- Assess performance of employees in line with organizational policies.

Planning

- The Project Manager is accountable for ensuring that all project activities are planned, coordinated, monitored, and executed in accordance with contractual milestones and company objectives.

- Support portfolio planning by providing resource forecasts, identifying capacity constraints and coordinating priorities across multiple projects.

- Report on regular base to the senior management the status.

Functional

- Actively lead the project team (in the boundaries of the company rules, regulations, procedures)

- Facilitate and coordinate all activities concurring to project realization (hull plus Outfitting)

- Ensure engineering deliverables are released according to project milestones and actively manage technical changes, assessing impacts on cost, schedule, production efficiency, and contractual obligations.

- Coordinate information packages for production

- Accountable for templatizing the allocated ship type

- Monitor critical procurement packages and long lead items. Lead recovery actions for delayed deliveries and ensure material readiness supports the production and commissioning plan.

- Support production flow by coordinating engineering, procurement and production readiness. Escalate bottlenecks impacting the agreed build sequence and project milestones.

- Decision maker in case of conflicts, rescheduling, extra works, etc.

- Ensure commissioning, harbour acceptance tests and sea trials are planned and executed in accordance with contractual and class requirements.

- Accountable for the overall quality of the vessel. Production is responsible for create quality, QC check.

- Validate remarks in Rdrive and reallocate it.

- Maintain project risk and opportunity registers. Develop mitigation plans and proactively report significant project risks to management.

- Utilize digital tools and dashboards to monitor progress, productivity, cost performance, forecast accuracy and project risks.

- Act as the primary customer interface and maintain positive stakeholder relationships throughout project execution, acceptance, delivery and warranty phases.

- Contact person for Client representatives and or client site teams

Financial

The Project Manager is accountable for the financial performance of assigned projects and shall:

Budget & Forecast

• Own project budget from contract handover through project closure.

• Prepare and maintain monthly Estimate at Completion (EAC).

• Continuously forecast final project result and cash flow.

• Ensure forecast accuracy within agreed company tolerance.

Cost Control

• Monitor project cost performance against budget.

• Analyze cost deviations and define corrective actions.

• Monitor:

o Engineering hours

o Production hours

o Rework hours

o Material consumption

o Subcontractor costs

o Commissioning & trial costs

For DSCS, where MES and Power BI data are available, this should become a core PM responsibility.

Change & Variation Management

• Identify potential contract variations early.

• Quantify cost and schedule impacts.

• Coordinate VTC/change order preparation.

• Ensure recovery of additional costs from customers where contractually possible.

Margin Protection

• Protect project gross margin through proactive management of:

o Scope changes

o Design changes

o Delays

o Material escalation

o Supplier claims

Financial Reporting

• Present project financial status during Management Review meetings.

• Escalate financial risks promptly.

• Maintain financial transparency toward stakeholders.

Improvement

Facilitate project lessons learned reviews and contribute to the standardization of project management practices, templates and reporting tools.

Job requirements

Communication/ Cooperation

- Communicates clearly, effectively, and professionally with customers, suppliers, management, and cross-functional teams.

- Translates complex technical, commercial, and operational issues into clear actions and decisions.

- Builds strong collaborative relationships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, Finance, and Commissioning departments.

- Facilitates constructive discussions and resolves conflicts to maintain project progress.

- Adapts communication style to different audiences, including customers, senior management, and shop-floor personnel.

- Promotes transparency, teamwork, and knowledge sharing throughout the project lifecycle.

- Ensures timely escalation of risks, issues, and decision requirements.

postings.title: Risk Manager
postings.description:
We offer you an Ocean of Possibilities. Join our family.

About us

Risk management within Damen Shipyards Group has taken a significant step forward with the introduction of the Group Risk Board in 2019. This independent advisory body supports the Executive Board in decision-making for projects above a defined contract threshold during the commercial phase of the project lifecycle.

At divisional level, risk management is actively embedded in daily operations. Multidisciplinary teams identify and manage risks throughout the project lifecycle, while the Group Risk Management team defines the overarching risk framework, standards and methodologies, and provides guidance and support to the divisions.

As a Risk Manager at Group level, you operate at the intersection of strategy, projects and governance. For selected complex or high-impact projects, you are directly involved — from the commercial phase through execution — ensuring that risks are identified early, well understood and actively managed.

The role

As Risk Manager (Group), you play a key role in strengthening risk awareness and decision-making across Damen. You work closely with project teams, divisional management and Group stakeholders to ensure that operational, financial and contractual risks are transparently assessed and effectively mitigated.

This is a hands-on, advisory role with real influence: you lead risk workshops, translate complex risks into clear insights, and help teams make better-informed choices. The role is primarily based at Group level, with limited travel (approximately once per quarter).

Key accountabilities

In this role, you will:

- Conduct risk assessments during the commercial and execution phases of shipbuilding and related projects
- Facilitate multidisciplinary risk workshops with stakeholders from Engineering, Project Management, Finance, Legal and Supply Chain
- Identify, analyze and prioritize operational, financial, contractual and planning risks, and support teams in defining practical mitigation measures
- Maintain and further develop project risk registers, ensuring consistency with Group standards
- Support divisions in applying the Group risk management framework, tools and ways of working
- Analyze risk trends across projects, identify recurring themes and contribute to continuous improvement and lessons learned
- Provide clear risk insights and reports to divisional management and, where relevant, the Group Risk Board

Skills & experience

We are looking for a Risk Manager who brings structure, judgement and communication skills:

- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g. Engineering, Naval Architecture, Business Administration or similar)
- 3–5 years of experience in risk management, project control, project management or a related role, preferably in technically complex project environments (e.g. shipbuilding, manufacturing, infrastructure, energy)
- Experience with operational and financial risk assessments and defining mitigation strategies
- Familiarity with enterprise or project risk management frameworks (e.g. ISO 31000) is a strong plus
- Ability to analyze risk information, recognize patterns and translate insights into clear recommendations
- Strong communication skills in English and Dutch, with confidence to facilitate workshops and engage senior stakeholders
- A proactive, structured and independent working style, with the ability to manage multiple projects in parallel

What we offer

At Damen, you will join a professional and growing Group Risk function, where your expertise and development are taken seriously. We offer:

- A Group-level role with exposure to diverse projects across the Damen organization
- Limited travel (approximately once per quarter) and a healthy work–life balance
- The salary for this position ranges between € 4.500 and € 6.000 gross per month (based on a full-time contract), excluding holiday allowance. The exact salary will depend on your knowledge and experience. This position is part of the colllective labour agreement Metalektro.
- A dynamic, international and technology-driven working environment
- Opportunities for professional growth, learning and development within risk management and project environments
- An open and socially active company culture, with room for initiative and ownership

Are you a Risk Manager looking to deepen your impact in a complex, project-driven environment — without constant travel?
Then this role at Damen Shipyards Group offers the scope, influence and development you are looking for.

postings.description:
We offer you an Ocean of Possibilities. Join our family.

About us

Are you passionate about creating a safe and healthy workplace? Do you enjoy working closely with operational teams to drive continuous improvement in safety performance and compliance? Are you proactive, observant, and committed to making a real difference in a dynamic industrial environment? Then this role could be your next step. Apply now!

Damen Song Cam Shipyard (DSCS) is a joint venture between Damen Shipyards Group and Song Cam Shipyard. As a strategic production yard within the Damen Shipyards Group, DSCS specializes in the design, construction, outfitting, commissioning, and delivery of high-quality tugboats and workboats for customers worldwide. The shipyard combines international shipbuilding expertise with local capabilities to deliver innovative, reliable, and sustainable vessels.

The Health, Safety, Environment & Quality (HSEQ) Department is responsible for monitoring and improving management systems related to occupational health and safety, environmental management, and quality assurance in accordance with ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 requirements. The department plays a key role in promoting a culture of safety and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

The Role

As a Safety Officer, you will support the effective implementation of the Company's Health, Safety and Environmental (HSE) management system by ensuring compliance with legal requirements, company standards, and best practices.

You will conduct workplace inspections, monitor safety performance, support incident investigations, provide safety training, and cooperate with operational departments to continuously improve workplace safety and environmental performance. The role requires close interaction with employees, subcontractors, management teams, and external organizations to promote a proactive safety culture across the shipyard.

Key Responsibilities

As a Safety Officer, your main responsibilities are:

Workplace Safety & Compliance

- Conduct regular safety inspections and occupational health and safety audits across workshops and operational areas.
- Identify unsafe acts and unsafe conditions, issue recommendations, and exercise stop-work authority when serious safety violations are identified.
- Monitor compliance with HSE procedures, legal requirements, and company safety standards.
- Issue and control Permit-to-Work (PTW) activities within assigned areas.
- Monitor and administer the R-Drive and Work Permit systems.
- Support the implementation and communication of HSE policies, procedures, and workplace instructions.

Incident Prevention & Investigation

- Investigate incidents, accidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions.
- Analyze root causes and propose corrective and preventive actions.
- Follow up on HSE findings to ensure timely closure and sustainable improvement.
- Prepare reports and communicate HSE performance to relevant stakeholders.

Emergency Response & Fire Safety

- Participate in emergency response activities, including fire-fighting, evacuation exercises, environmental incidents, flooding, and workplace accidents.
- Inspect, monitor, and maintain fire-fighting equipment and emergency response readiness.
- Support the development and execution of emergency drills and preparedness programs.

Training & Safety Awareness

- Deliver toolbox meetings and safety briefings.
- Conduct HSE induction training and awareness programs for employees and subcontractors.
- Promote safety campaigns and initiatives to strengthen the safety culture within the organization.
- Support the implementation of behavioral safety improvement programs.

Contractor & Audit Management

- Monitor subcontractor HSE performance and report safety issues.
- Support internal and external HSE audits, inspections, and certification activities.
- Coordinate with external authorities, certification bodies, and inspection organizations when required.
- Assist departments in implementing improvement actions arising from inspections and audits.

Continuous Improvement

- Identify risks, improvement opportunities, and best practices related to workplace safety and environmental management.
- Support HSE improvement projects and initiatives.
- Convert legal, regulatory, and management system requirements into practical guidance for operational departments.
- Collaborate with Production and other departments to improve safe working methods and ensure compliance with company procedures.

Skills & Experience

To be successful in this role, you bring:

Education

- College Degree or higher in Occupational Safety, Environmental Management, Engineering, Industrial Management, or another relevant discipline.

Experience

- Minimum 1–3 years of relevant experience in occupational health and safety within a manufacturing, industrial, shipbuilding, construction, or similar environment.
- Experience conducting safety inspections, audits, incident investigations, and safety training activities is preferred.
- Knowledge of ISO 45001, ISO 14001, and relevant Vietnamese HSE regulations is an advantage.

Competencies

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to identify key risks and anticipate potential consequences.
- Good communication, influencing, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to persuade and engage stakeholders to follow safety requirements and best practices.
- Strong observation skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to work independently while effectively cooperating with cross-functional teams.
- Proactive mindset with a continuous improvement orientation.
- Good command of English is an advantage.

What We Offer

At Damen, we understand that our success depends on finding the right people and supporting them throughout their career journey. We offer:

- A dynamic international working environment focused on safety, technology, and operational excellence.
- Competitive salary package.
- Holiday bonus, Tet bonus, and quarterly bonus.

- 24/7 accident insurance and healthcare insurance for employees and spouses.
- Full statutory social insurance and personal income tax administration in accordance with applicable regulations.
- Business trip allowance where applicable.
- Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
- Opportunities to grow within an international shipbuilding organization.

Other

We are looking for an enthusiastic and entrepreneurial Sales Manager to join our Sales Benelux team.

The sales department is divided into seven areas, namely the Benelux, North, West & South Europe, East & South East Europe, the Americas, the Middle East, Africa and Asia Pacific. The diversity between sales activities and the consequent market approach in the seven areas is extensive because of the differences in product types, distribution, types of customers, collaboration with agents, political influences, government regulations, method of project funding etc. Area Sales Directors and Sales Managers are frequently required to travel. The trips usually consist of visits to prospective and (existing) customers. Partners include: employees at government agencies, port operators, shipping companies, contractors and marine service companies. The Sales Manager is responsible for the local sales activities and turnover in a number of countries within the area.

In order to strengthen our sales team, we have a vacancy for a Sales Manager Benelux with a focus on the Netherlands, but in the future possibly also Belgium and Luxembourg.

The role

As a sales manager, you are responsible for all sales activities and act as the primary contact for the customer for the Damen portfolio within assigned countries/ area. You build sustainable customer relationships, identify needs and trends, sell and provide input for the development of the Damen portfolio and oversee aftersales in line with developed sales plan and Damen strategy. Goal of the job is to realize sales objectives and create customer loyalty in the assigned territory to contribute to an increase in the market share, turnover and profits of Damen. On average, the sales manager travels 120 days a year. These trips mainly exist of visiting prospects and clients inside the area 1 region, but also visiting our shipyards, fairs and exhibitions outside of the area 1 region together with clients.

- Proactively identify and develop market opportunities through client acquisition, visits, trade fairs, and other marketing activities, providing strategic market insights to management.

postings.title: Scheepsonderhoudsmonteur
SCR Commissioning Engineer
postings.description:
We offer you an Ocean of Possibilities. Join our family.

About us

Are you passionate about marine engine technology, emission control systems, and vessel commissioning? Do you enjoy solving technical challenges, working directly on vessels, and ensuring that complex systems perform according to international standards?

Then this opportunity could be your next career step.

Damen Song Cam Shipyard (DSCS) is part of Damen Shipyards Group, one of the world's leading shipbuilders. We design, build, commission, and deliver high-quality tugboats and workboats for customers worldwide.

As environmental regulations continue to evolve, advanced emission-reduction technologies play a critical role in modern shipbuilding. To support the growing implementation of IMO Tier III solutions, Damen Song Cam is looking for an experienced SCR Commissioning Engineer to join our Commissioning & Sea Trials Department. The role will contribute directly to the successful commissioning, testing, and delivery of vessels equipped with Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR) systems.

The Role

As an SCR Commissioning Engineer, you are responsible for the preparation, commissioning, testing, troubleshooting, optimization, and acceptance of SCR (Selective Catalytic Reduction) systems installed onboard Damen vessels.

You will work closely with Project Teams, Commissioning Engineers, OEM suppliers, Classification Societies, and Customers to ensure SCR systems comply with IMO Tier III emissions requirements and operate safely, efficiently, and reliably throughout vessel trials and delivery.

The position is part of the Commissioning & Sea Trials Department and involves participation in harbor trials, sea trials, vessel acceptance tests, and delivery activities.

Key Responsibilities

Commissioning & Testing

As an SCR Commissioning Engineer, you will:

- Perform pre-commissioning inspections of SCR systems, including piping, instrumentation, electrical interfaces, sensors, actuators, and auxiliary equipment.
- Execute commissioning activities in accordance with approved commissioning procedures and OEM requirements.
- Commission and validate: SCR reactor systems Urea dosing systems Air supply systems Urea transfer and storage systems NOx monitoring and control systems HMI and automation interfaces
- Verify system functionality, alarms, interlocks, and safety protections.
- Support dock trials, yard trials, harbor acceptance tests (HAT), and sea acceptance tests (SAT).

Troubleshooting & Optimization

- Diagnose system faults and technical issues during commissioning and sea-trial phases.
- Analyze NOx reduction performance and optimize system settings when required.
- Coordinate corrective actions with suppliers, engineering teams, and project stakeholders.
- Support root-cause analysis and technical investigations.
- Verify system performance against contractual and regulatory requirements.

Documentation & Compliance

- Prepare commissioning reports, checklists, punch lists, and test documentation.
- Maintain commissioning records and ensure complete technical documentation for handover.
- Verify compliance with: IMO Tier III requirements Classification Society regulations Vendor specifications Damen commissioning procedures
- Support regulatory certification activities and customer acceptance processes.

Collaboration & Support

- Coordinate with Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, and Software Commissioning Engineers.
- Provide technical guidance related to SCR systems during vessel construction and commissioning.
- Support customer training and operational handover activities.
- Liaise with OEM specialists and Damen Aftertreatment experts when required.
- Support future SCR system improvements and standardization initiatives across Damen projects.

Skills & Experience

To be successful in this role, you bring:

Education

- Bachelor’s Degree in Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline.

Experience

- Minimum 3 years of experience in marine engineering, commissioning, propulsion systems, aftertreatment systems, or industrial process systems.
- Experience in vessel commissioning, marine engines, exhaust systems, or emission-control technologies is preferred.
- Experience working within shipbuilding, marine, offshore, power generation, or heavy industrial environments.

Technical Knowledge

- Knowledge of: Marine diesel engines Exhaust gas systems SCR technology Urea dosing systems PLC/HMI systems Instrumentation and control systems
- Understanding of: IMO Tier III regulations NOx emission control requirements Marine commissioning practices Classification Society requirements
- Ability to interpret technical drawings, P&IDs, electrical diagrams, and commissioning procedures.

Competencies

- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
- Hands-on approach and practical problem-solving mindset.
- Strong communication and coordination skills.
- Ability to work independently and under pressure during project-critical phases.
- Willingness to travel and participate in vessel sea trials and delivery voyages.
- Good command of English, both written and spoken.

What We Offer

At Damen, we understand that our success depends on finding the right people and supporting them throughout their development.

We offer:

- A dynamic international working environment focused on technology and innovation.
- Competitive salary package.
- Holiday bonus, Tet bonus, and quarterly bonus.

- Full statutory social insurance in accordance with Vietnamese regulations.
- Business-trip allowances for commissioning and sea-trial activities where applicable.

- Opportunities to work with global Damen specialists and advanced marine technologies.

Other

Ready to help shape the future of sustainable shipbuilding? Join Damen Song Cam Shipyard and contribute to the commissioning of next-generation IMO Tier III vessels.

postings.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
postings.description:
We offer you an Ocean of Possibilities. Join our family.

Over ons

Damen Marine Components (DMC) ontwikkelt en produceert hoogwaardige systemen voor de voortstuwing, manoeuvreerbaarheid en prestaties van schepen wereldwijd. Onze producten worden toegepast in onder andere de binnenvaart, offshore, deepsea, marinesector en superjachtbouw.

Met innovatieve oplossingen zoals roeren, stuurmachines, straalbuizen, lieren en besturingssystemen dragen wij dagelijks bij aan efficiëntere, veiligere en duurzamere schepen. Daarnaast ondersteunen wij klanten wereldwijd met een professioneel 24/7 servicenetwerk.

DMC is onderdeel van de Damen Shipyards Group.

De functie

Ben jij een ervaren mechanical engineer die energie krijgt van complexe technische vraagstukken én van producten die daadwerkelijk worden gebouwd en varen? Dan is dit een rol waarin je jouw technische expertise maximaal kunt inzetten.

Als Senior Mechanical Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp, de ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van mechanische en hydraulische systemen voor de maritieme sector. Je werkt aan producten zoals roeren, stuurmachines, straalbuizen en hydraulische power units, maar voor een belangrijk deel aan het Damen Air Cavity System (DACS).

DACS is een geavanceerd luchtsmeringssysteem dat een luchtlaag onder het schip creëert. Hierdoor neemt de weerstand in het water af, wat leidt tot een lager brandstofverbruik en minder emissies. Als Senior Mechanical Engineer speel je een belangrijke rol in de verdere ontwikkeling, engineering en integratie van dit systeem aan boord van uiteenlopende scheepstypen. Veel schepen gaan de komende jaren hun bestaande vloot vergroenen. Hiermee maak je een directe groene impact in de scheepvaart.

Je bent betrokken vanaf de eerste conceptfase tot en met productie, installatie en inbedrijfstelling. Daarbij vertaal je klantwensen en technische eisen naar slimme, maakbare en betrouwbare ontwerpen. Je voert technische berekeningen uit, ontwikkelt 2D- en 3D-modellen en zorgt ervoor dat ontwerpen voldoen aan classificatie-eisen, kwaliteitsnormen en projectafspraken.

Dankzij jouw ervaring neem je technische verantwoordelijkheid binnen projecten. Je analyseert complexe vraagstukken, maakt onderbouwde ontwerpkeuzes en bewaakt de technische kwaliteit gedurende het gehele traject. Daarnaast coördineer je engineeringactiviteiten en stuur je waar nodig externe engineeringpartners aan.

Voor DACS-projecten ben je nauw betrokken bij de technische integratie aan boord. Je werkt daarbij samen met klanten, scheepswerven, classificatiebureaus en interne stakeholders om ervoor te zorgen dat het systeem optimaal functioneert binnen het totale scheepsontwerp.

Samen met collega's uit engineering, projectmanagement, productie, service en sales realiseer je innovatieve oplossingen die wereldwijd worden toegepast.

Wat ga je doen?

- Beheren, doorontwikkelen en optimaliseren van een productportfolio in samenwerking met Product Management.
- Ontwerpen en engineeren van mechanische en hydraulische systemen.
- Opstellen en beoordelen van 2D- en 3D-CAD-modellen, conceptontwerpen, General Arrangements en productietekeningen.
- Uitvoeren van mechanische en sterkteberekeningen.
- Ondersteunen van sales, projectmanagement, productie, service en quality control.
- Initiëren van technische verbeteringen en productinnovaties.
- Begeleiden en beoordelen van engineeringwerkzaamheden die door externe partijen worden uitgevoerd.
- Samenwerken in multidisciplinaire teams binnen een internationale projectomgeving.
- Technische begeleiding bieden bij de integratie van DACS-installaties en andere complexe maritieme systemen.

Wat breng je mee?

- HBO werk- en denkniveau richting Werktuigbouwkunde, Scheepsbouwkunde, Maritieme Techniek of vergelijkbaar.
- Minimaal 7 jaar relevante ervaring binnen werktuigbouwkunde, machinebouw of de maritieme sector.
- Ervaring met 2D- en 3D-CAD software zoals SolidWorks, Inventor of AutoCAD.
- Kennis van FEM-analyses en sterkteberekeningen.
- Ervaring met ERP- en CRM-systemen.
- Hydraulische kennis is een pré.
- Bekendheid met eisen van classificatiebureaus zoals DNV, Bureau Veritas en Lloyd's Register.
- Goede beheersing van de Engelse taal.
- Een pragmatische, zelfstandige en resultaatgerichte werkhouding.

Waarom kiezen voor DMC?

Bij DMC werk je niet aan standaard engineeringprojecten, maar aan innovatieve technologie die wereldwijd wordt ingezet. Je krijgt veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en invloed op de ontwikkeling van producten die daadwerkelijk het verschil maken in de maritieme sector.

Wij bieden:

- Een goed salaris.
- Minimaal 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen.
- De mogelijkheid om deels vanuit huis te werken.
- Volop ruimte voor technische en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.
- Directe invloed op innovatieve projecten en productontwikkeling.
- Een informele werksfeer met korte lijnen en betrokken collega's.
- De kans om mee te bouwen aan duurzame technologieën zoals het Damen Air Cavity System (DACS).

Wil jij jouw engineeringkennis inzetten voor innovatieve maritieme technologie en bijdragen aan de verduurzaming van de scheepvaart? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

postings.title: Senior Project Estimator
postings.description:
We offer you an Ocean of Possibilities. Join our family.

About us

Damen Shiprepair Rotterdam is part of the Damen Shiprepair and Conversion group. A division that focuses on repair, maintenance, refit and conversion of various types of ships across a wide range of markets such as Offshore oil & gas, installation vessels for wind turbines, Navy and Transport. The organization is characterized by modern business operations in which the customer is central and we can respond efficiently on fluctuating market conditions and operate in a demand-driven supply chain.

The role

The Project Estimator (or Cost Engineer) is part of a team of 5-8 Estimators led by a Team Leader within the Sales Department. We have a very driven team of estimators who all have a passion for ships, numbers and technology. They will be happy to show you our premises, share their knowledge and experience and welcome you at our yard.

This technical-commercial function is aimed at determining the cost price of maritime projects as accurately as possible, the basis of the cost will be the information supplied by the customer. This cost price calculation is used as a basis to determine the correct sales price and project lead time. The budget calculation is also a starting point for the preparation and the actual assignment execution. The Estimating Department ensures that project considerations are based on the best possible data / calculations, this in order to both increase the chance of getting projects awarded and decrease the chance of accepting loss-making projects. The ship repair market is characterized by limited predictability. For example, the scope of activities between the initial assessment of applications to completion can differ greatly. Properly recording/describing the work offered, often in English, is an important point in creating a risk-averse quote.

Key accountabilities

In the role as Senior Project Estimator you will have the following tasks and responsibilities:

- Independently draw up quotations for repair, regular maintenance, conversions and construction works. You do this on the basis of the data, such as technical specification and drawings, issued by our customers. You analyze and assess this data and you consult with the customer to get a clear picture of the requested scope of work.
- You work closely with the purchasing department, subcontractors and suppliers in order to draw up an optimal total budget taking into account vessels arrival date, planning and delivery times.
- You participate in pre-bid meetings and site visits as required which may result in travel time on occasion in the Netherland and abroad.
- Makes timely, accurate and complete cost calculations, including a correct formulation of the technical specifications.
- Collect tender documents where appropriate based on the specifications and (working) drawings supplied by the customer. Prepares a counter specification if necessary.
- Plans own work, monitors the realization of agreements on the delivery of calculations and other deliverables.
- Provides, if desired or requested by the customer, a project planning based on the work offered in our quotation.
- Occasional provision of preliminary / basic engineering data to support the quotation. This in collaboration with our colleagues from the work preparation and production department.
- Must be constantly aware of new developments and activities in his field and field of work (both in terms of calculation and ship repair).
- Consults internal files with key figures and standards. Requests timely quotes from suppliers and subcontractors.
- If necessary, visit ships for inspecting the works in the Netherlands and abroad to obtain additional information and to assess the specification and technical data. Contributes to consultations with the customer in which the scope, technical (im)possibilities and customer wishes are discussed. Contributes his expertise and strives for a complete quote. Prepares (final) budget.

Skills & experience

As a Senior Project Estimator, you recognize yourself in the following profile:

- Higher or secondary technical education level with affinity both commercial and technical, e.g.: Engineering, Shipbuilding, Technical Business Administration or equivalent.
- Extensive knowledge of estimating and cost structures within ship repair
- You're flexible, accurate and a team player.
- Your English, verbally and written, is proficient and you are an EU citizen.
- Knowledge of MS Excel, MS Projects and other relevant software.
- Used to working in teams, with a service providing and flexible attitude.
- We expect candidates to have extensive knowledge of the ship repair market and ship repair techniques.
- Broad technical knowledge is of course also essential. A mechanical or naval engineering background would be a good fit. The professional we are looking for preferably has experience in the estimation of maritime projects or comes from a technical environment with common ground for this position.

What we offer

At DSR, you will work on impressive projects unlike anything you will find elsewhere.

We place great value on supporting and guiding talented professionals. That is why we continuously invest in your development and offer:

- A dynamic and international work environment with an informal atmosphere;
- A competitive salary (CLA Metalektro);
- 27 vacation days and 13 additional leave days based on a full-time position;
- Travel allowance (up to 40 km one way);
- Profit sharing and pension contribution;
- Continuous focus on professional and personal development.

Why join Damen?
At Damen Shiprepair, you’ll have the opportunity to develop yourself in an international and technically driven working environment. We offer a workplace where reliability, collaboration, and continuous improvement are key. Together, we ensure the continuity and performance of vessels around the world, and shape the future of ship repair.

Ready to come aboard?

Does Damen Shiprepair sound like the right Damen environment for you? And are you the driven Senior Project Estimator we are looking for? Then apply directly via this page. We look forward to receiving your CV and motivation letter.

If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact our recruiter, Jonathan de Ruiter.

postings.title: Stage IT Business Systems
postings.description:
We offer you an Ocean of Possibilities. Join our family.

Over ons

Stap aan boord bij Damen Naval; de marine divisie van het familiebedrijf Damen Shipyards Group waar wereldwijd 12.000 professionals werken. Damen Naval levert geavanceerde marineschepen aan klanten over de hele wereld. Door de meest innovatieve technologische ontwikkelingen in de praktijk toe te passen, blijven we de grenzen verleggen van de scheepsbouwsector. Jij kunt deel uitmaken van ons team! Are you ready for duty?

De Rol
Tijdens je stage maak je deel uit van onze Business Systems-afdeling. Je werkt mee aan het beheer en de doorontwikkeling van onze business systems: clusters van één of meerdere applicaties die een essentiële rol spelen binnen onze bedrijfsprocessen.

Als afdeling zijn we verantwoordelijk voor het monitoren van applicaties, het oplossen van incidenten en het waarborgen van de continuïteit en beschikbaarheid van onze systemen. Ook analyseren we gebruikerswensen en bedrijfsprocessen om verbeteringen door te voeren. Denk hierbij aan het configureren van functionaliteiten, het begeleiden van updates en het implementeren van nieuwe features binnen bestaande systemen.

Ook softwareontwikkeling maakt onderdeel uit van Business Systems. Hierdoor krijg je inzicht in de volledige lifecycle van applicaties: van implementatie en beheer tot modernisering en uitfasering. Daarbij besteden we aandacht aan onderwerpen zoals performance, security, integraties en de toekomstbestendigheid van onze systemen.

Je stage

Tijdens de eerste fase van je stage leer je onze organisatie, processen en systemen kennen. Je maakt kennis met collega's uit verschillende teams en ontdekt hoe applicaties en integraties onze business ondersteunen. Zo krijg je een goed beeld van hoe wij zorgen voor betrouwbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige systemen.

Plan van Aanpak

In deze eerste fase stel je samen met je begeleider een plan van aanpak op. Hierin werk je jouw stageopdracht, leerdoelen en aanpak uit. Je opdracht valt binnen één of meerdere van de volgende thema's:

- Optimalisatie van processen en systemen
- Automatisering van terugkerende werkzaamheden
- Data-analyse en rapportages rondom gebruik en performance

Denk bijvoorbeeld aan het verbeteren van support- en beheerprocessen, het automatiseren van handmatige werkzaamheden, het optimaliseren van ontwikkelprocessen of het ontwikkelen van dashboards en inzichten op basis van incidentdata of applicatiegebruik.

Flexibele invulling

De exacte invulling van je stageopdracht bepalen we samen, zodat deze aansluit bij jouw leerdoelen, interesses én de actuele vraagstukken binnen ons team. Je krijgt de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, met ideeën te komen en daadwerkelijk impact te maken op de manier waarop wij onze business systems beheren en verbeteren. Zo ontwikkel je niet alleen technische kennis, maar ook belangrijke vaardigheden op het gebied van communicatie, analyse en samenwerking binnen een professionele projectorganisatie.

Begeleiding

Gedurende je stage word je begeleid door ervaren collega’s en werk je samen met zowel IT-specialisten als business stakeholders. Hierdoor ontwikkel je niet alleen technische kennis, maar ook belangrijke vaardigheden op het gebied van communicatie, analyse en samenwerking binnen een professionele organisatie.

Wat we bieden

Bij Damen Naval hechten we veel waarde aan onze stagiaires en ondersteunen we je professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Daarnaast bieden we onze medewerkers:

- Een maandelijkse vergoeding voor de duur van de opdracht.
- Gedegen begeleiding gedurende het hele project.
- De mogelijkheid om je professionele en sociale vaardigheden te testen en te verbeteren.
- Werkervaring bij een toonaangevend bedrijf die een waardevolle aanvulling vormt op je cv

Deze stage sluit goed aan bij studenten van mbo- en hbo-opleidingen binnen ICT, zoals Software Engineering, Data Science en Business IT & Management. Volg je een andere relevante opleiding? Dan bekijken we graag samen de mogelijkheden.

#LI-MM2​

postings.title: Steel & Welding QC Supervisor (Vietnamese only)
postings.description:
We offer you an Ocean of Possibilities. Join our family.

JOB CONTEXT

Damen Song Cam Shipyard is engineering, outfitting, commissioning and delivering various Damen standard ship types. Basic designs and most components are delivered to DSCS by Damen Shipyards Gorinchem. DSCS will complete the detailed design, and production information, which will be used during the assembly of the vessels.

The Quality Control (QC) department is securing quality in a way that supports maximum efficiency of the production activity. QC is an important initiator of product and process improvements.

PURPOSE AND SCOPE OF THE JOB

Perform inspections and monitor inspection processes and tests related to production activities: Hull construction and welding. Secure the quality of steelwork and welding activity in DSCS.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES/ ACTIVITIES

Pre-inspection

- Review contract documentation/specifications/quality plans to identify the quality requirements and documentation deliverables.
- Advise to develop an Inspection Test Plan (ITP) Hull part and necessary QC procedures when required
- Review a traceability of materials, storage conditions, hull building / construction material and welding consumables
- Review Non Destructive Testing (NDT) plan approval by Class
- Review of welder qualification, WPS, WPQ

Material inspection

- Inspect the quality of incoming raw material and products related to steel and welding.

Hull construction Inspection

- Carry out welding inspections at all stages of the process
- Fit-Up Inspection (Including surveillance of pre-heat requirements)
- In-Process Welding Inspection
- Coordinating NDT process and witness NDT work
- Final Visual Inspection of Completed Welds.

Testing

- Testing ( Leak Test / Pressure test)

Quality awareness

- Investigate identified quality issues and develop effective corrective actions and initiate actions to avoid future error
- Advise production to improve a steel construction and welding activities
- Issue a Non-conformity report (NCR), quality observation report and outstanding items. Follow up when items are done by relative department to close, giving repair advice where necessary.

Communication

- Contact with Project team and Class Societies for verification of production activities

QC documents

- Maintain inspection reports
- Update and distribute project inspection progress report and Outstanding item list
- Managing all documents work / test report / material certificates
- Manage and store technical acceptance documents of nominated projects

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education

- Graduated university, major in Shipbuilding / Marine / Welding Engineering
- English language and computer skills

Experience

- Independent working
- 2-3 years related work experience in shipyard environment.

What we offer

Here at Damen, we realize supporting and managing many talented individuals is of great essence. We understand that the key to success is to find the right person for the right job. That’s why we continually invest in your development. Damen offers you:

- a dynamic international working environment focusing on technology and innovation;
- a competitive salary;
- holiday bonus, Tet bonus, quarter bonus;
- monthly fuel allowance;
- 24/7 insurance + health insurance for employee and spouse
- social insurance
- business trip allowance (if any);
- continuous focus on professional and personal development through training programs.

Other

Damen Song Cam does not approve of a commercial, contractor and/or agency acquisition or commercial use of this advertisement. Proposing candidates without invitation is not appreciated and will not be considered.

postings.title: Stock controller (Vietnamese only)
postings.description:
We offer you an Ocean of Possibilities. Join our family.

About us:

Damen Song Cam Shipyard Co., Ltd (DSCS) is a joint venture between Damen Workboats in the Netherlands (70%) and Song Cam Shipyard (30%), member of SBIC and based in Haiphong, Vietnam. At a 42 hectares site just outside Haiphong, Damen Song Cam is a strategic and preferred production location within the Damen Workboats to produce tug- and workboats up to 60 meters. At the moment the shipyard is a dedicated outfitting shipyard: up to 40 hulls are procured from our partner shipyards. DSCS is performing outfitting, commissioning and delivery to clients worldwide. The strategy to grow is successful. Growth in volume, expanding the product portfolio, expanding other maritime activities (services, supervision) within the group.

The role:

The principal duty of a stock controller is to organize and monitor stock levels to maximize efficiency. The Stock Controller, monitors and coordinates activities related to demand of raw material and inventory parts to ensure that all business operations have the right material at the right time to achieve their objectives.

Key accountabilities:

- Develop and Optimize inventory stock control procedures:

- Inform Demand people to use leftover
- Reduce quantity buy too much but not consume quick
- Find out why material was ordered but not using

- Determine the structure of the stock:

- Redefine Commodity group for managing stock.

- Annalise the levels of business supplies and raw material to identify shortages:

- Based on situation of material in IFS to forecast shortages and react.

- Monitor daily stock:

- Monitor daily deliveries and shipments to reconcile the levels of order points for grab store and anonymous materials.

- Use software to monitor demand and document characteristics of inventory:

- Create quick report to monitor demand

- Approve consolidated orders to replenish stock avoiding insufficiencies or excessive surplus:

- Release MRP and INV Purchase Requisition
- Reuse surplus

- Analyze data to anticipate future needs and trends generated by a long term portfolio…

- Based on aging, turnover and other reports to analyze and see future situation

- Collaborate with warehouse employees, material coordinators and purchasers to ensure business goals are met:

About Us

Are you an experienced maritime professional with strong leadership capabilities and a passion for delivering high-quality vessels? Do you enjoy working in a dynamic international shipbuilding environment where safety, quality, and operational excellence are key priorities? Then this opportunity could be your next career step.

Damen Song Cam Shipyard (DSCS) is part of the Damen Shipyards Group, a leading global shipbuilder specializing in the design and construction of tugboats, workboats, and high-speed crafts. Through standardized and smart-customized shipbuilding solutions, Damen continuously delivers innovative and reliable vessels to customers worldwide.

With shipbuilding facilities in Hai Phong, Vietnam, and cooperation across Damen shipyards globally, we strive to become the world's most sustainable and connected shipbuilder.

The Role

As a Trial Captain, you are responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing sea trials for newly built vessels to ensure they meet contractual, regulatory, and operational requirements before delivery to clients.

You will act as the operational leader during sea trials and vessel delivery voyages, coordinating activities between project teams, classification societies, customers, subcontractors, and vessel crews. Your expertise will contribute directly to the successful completion and handover of high-quality vessels that meet Damen standards.

The Trial Captain works within the Commissioning & Sea Trial Department, collaborating closely with project managers, commissioning engineers, production teams, and external stakeholders throughout vessel testing and delivery phases.

Key Responsibilities

As a Trial Captain, your responsibilities include:

- Planning, organizing, and leading harbor acceptance tests (HAT), sea acceptance tests (SAT), and vessel delivery trials.
- Acting as the primary operational authority onboard during trial and delivery activities.
- Coordinating trial programs with project teams, customers, classification societies, and relevant authorities.
- Verifying vessel performance against contractual specifications, regulatory requirements, and safety standards.
- Supervising trial crews, subcontractors, and operational personnel during testing activities.
- Monitoring navigation, propulsion, steering, maneuvering, safety systems, and overall vessel performance during trials.
- Identifying technical and operational deficiencies and coordinating corrective actions with relevant departments.
- Preparing and reviewing sea trial reports, observations, punch lists, and final acceptance documentation.
- Supporting vessel delivery voyages and ensuring successful handover to clients.
- Promoting and maintaining a strong safety culture throughout all trial and delivery activities.
- Ensuring compliance with company procedures, maritime regulations, class rules, and statutory requirements.

Skills & experience

Education

- Bachelor’s Degree in Navigation
- Valid maritime certificates of competency required for command-level functions.

Experience

- Minimum 5 years of seagoing experience, preferably in command positions or senior deck officer roles.
- Experience conducting vessel sea trials, commissioning activities, vessel delivery, or shipbuilding projects is highly preferred.
- Familiarity with tugboats, workboats, offshore vessels, or other commercial vessel operations is an advantage.
- Knowledge of international maritime regulations, class requirements, and safety management systems.

Competencies

- Strong leadership and decision-making capabilities.
- Excellent planning, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to work under pressure and solve operational challenges effectively.
- Strong safety awareness and commitment to operational excellence.
- Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
- Willingness to travel domestically and internationally for vessel trials and deliveries when required.

What we offer

At Damen, we believe our people are our greatest asset. We continuously invest in professional growth, innovation, and employee wellbeing.

We offer:

- A dynamic international working environment focused on technology and innovation.

- Holiday bonus, Tet bonus, and quarterly bonus.

- Opportunities to work on international shipbuilding projects with global Damen teams.

postings.title: Work preparator (Nhân viên chuẩn bị sản xuất) - Vietnamese only
postings.description:
We offer you an Ocean of Possibilities. Join our family.

About us:

Damen Song Cam Shipyard Co., Ltd (DSCS) is a joint venture between Damen Workboats in the Netherlands (70%) and Song Cam Shipyard (30%), member of SBIC and based in Haiphong, Vietnam. At a 42 hectares site just outside Haiphong, Damen Song Cam is a strategic and preferred production location within the Damen Workboats to produce tug- and workboats up to 60 meters. At the moment the shipyard is a dedicated outfitting shipyard: up to 45 hulls are procured from our partner shipyards. DSCS is performing outfitting, commissioning and delivery to clients worldwide. The strategy to grow is successful. Growth in volume, expanding the product portfolio, expanding other maritime activities (services, supervision) within the group.

Technical support department is one of four departments in Technical department of Damen Song Cam shipyard and is under supervision of Technical manager. Technical support department consists of following sub departments:

- Work Preparation

- Production Support

The role:

Work preparators must work in corporation with other teams to prepare information package for ships to be built at the DSCS yard, maintain and continuous improve quality of shop order and shop order structure.

Key accountabilities:

- In relation with Purchasing (in the case of buying parts):

- Compiles the information and makes it available, then sends the purchase requisition to the Purchasing department.
- Provide the deadline to buy supplies and parts for Purchasing department to follow to ensure the project progress.

- In relation to Production:

- Prepare the drawings, production information and Job list in the form of shop order.
- Provide full range of technical information and background to ensure on-time operation and progress.
- Send the Shop orders including deadline and essential information to complete for Production. This will serve as guideline for Production

- In relation to Stores and Logistics:

- Make shop order with available information for Store and Logistics to receive and transfer goods to the production areas.
- Send information needed to Logistics to buy small parts.

- Functional: Performs with minimum guidance for below tasks:

- Creating and maintaining production PBS
- Responsible for completeness and stability of template in terms of structure and content. (BOM, demand and shop orders)
- Responsible for the quality of the demand generated by templates: no demand in the past, alignment with the lead time, no latest order date in the past.
- Responsible for the standardization and quality of the shop orders content.
- Maintaining alignment between shop order planning and activity planning.
- Connect with Engineering and control the changes in production templates.
- Participate into the feedback loop and improve the quality of the templates.

- Improvement:

- Participate in the improvement of the process and his / her team performance

- General regulations:

- Compliance with company and employment regulations
- Keep the workplace clean and in order
- Meet the "HSEQ Statement" and applicable safety regulations (including legal obligations)

Skills & experience:

- Qualification in Shipbuilding / Mechanical/ Electrical Engineer
- Computer skills including AutoCAD, MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
- Technical insight
- Elementary written and verbal English skill
- 1-3 year experience in Shipbuilding (preferably in Damen yards), Mechanical/ Piping/ Electrical field.

Negotiation
